title: A Farewell to Alms

title: A New Kind of Science
author: Stephen Wolfram

scope: Focused V9 review of prior assessments and cited criticism; not a new full-text or score audit.

title: Blink

title: Built To Last
author: Jim Collins; Jerry I. Porras
reason: Outcome halos and retrospective selection challenge causal inference. Collins answers with matched comparisons, contemporaneous archives and an explicit correlation-only limitation. scope: Focused V9 review of prior assessments and cited criticism; not a new full-text or score audit.

title: Science at the Crossroads
author: Herbert Dingle
reason: V9 at high confidence, in addition to V1: the central claim that reciprocal time dilation is logically contradictory identifies ratios involving different events as the same clock-rate comparison. Correcting that identification removes the alleged contradiction, so the book’s case against special relativity must be abandoned or rebuilt. Dingle’s appeal to direct clock coincidences does not make the two event pairs identical. This is a specific inferential defect, not rejection by authority.
scope: Central clock argument, author defense, specialist rebuttal and retained prior assessment.
